The premium is a planning device (#34), never paid; the coordinator publishes predicted_cost/baseline_cost/predicted_savings and schedule[].price from the result and the accuracy promise (note_promise) reads result.prices.

findings.title: The realised capacity tracker keeps each day's LOWEST window, so the billed peak and the capacity line are understated
findings.claim: tariff._one_per_day keeps an entry when kw < best[day], so under distinct_days (the default) PeakTracker records each day's smallest closed window and billed_peak_kw reads 1.93 kW against 4.06 kW for three days of the winter_extreme capacity-tariff plan; 0.47-2.13 kW low on all 8 price shapes.
findings.mechanism: tariff.py:491 `elif day not in best or kw < best[day][0]` (docstring: 'Each dated day's highest entry'). _close_window folds every closed window through it, so a day's recorded peak walks down to its quietest window; billed_peak_kw (ledger capacity line via book_capacity, the published billed peak) and threshold_kw (the plan's capacity threshold) both read the understated list.

findings.title: A charge longer than one sample books its whole charge-start dip as a hot-water draw on every combi tank
findings.claim: With no hot water drawn at all, dhw_learning.DhwProfileLearner books the 4 K charge-start dip of a 60-minute charge into DrawStats as 3.016 kWh of draw (2.459 kWh on internal_coil), the whole dip, on all three combi_tank constructions, because ChargeSettle.advance takes back only rises seen on UNHEATED intervals and the reading recovers while the charge is still heated; the one-sample charge the take-back was built for books 0.039 kWh.
findings.mechanism: async_learn_dynamics folds every interval's beyond-standby drop into draw_stats (charge=started_heated or settling); the interval ending at the first heated sample is folded with charge=False (not provisional at all), and a dip on a later heated interval is provisional but ChargeSettle.advance returns 0 on every heated interval, so the recovery during the charge is never credited; the first unheated non-rise closes the charge with the dip still booked. The p90 ready target (dhw_draws.DrawStats.quantile) then asks the plan to hold more hot water than any draw needed.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out, up to three seats on the box; an energy figure, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-skip-heated: async_fold_draw_stats books no fall on an interval that starts or ends on a heated sample

findings.metric_definition: booked_kwh = sum of every DrawStats occurrence (closed + open) after a trace with zero real draw; identity 0 kWh
findings.phenomenon_property: A fall of the tank reading that a charge's loading transient explains is never booked as draw, whatever the charge's length relative to the sampling interval and whether the dip lands on the first or a later heated sample.

null_control.note: the 'short' shape (one-sample charge, dip recovers unheated) books 0.039 kWh on every cell: the take-back works where it was designed to

reproduction_steps: Run the harness; read the long_a/long_b booked figures per combi_tank cell against dip_equiv
Re-run with --perturb-skip-heated: every booked figure goes to 0
findings.proposed_fix_scope: dhw_learning: credit the dip's recovery across heated intervals of the open charge (or hold every charge-affected fall provisional until the charge closes), including the interval ending at the first heated sample

findings.title: Ceiling-probe intervals metered at the pump's floor become the solve's learned top: the planned max drops 6.0 -> 1.5 kW
findings.claim: draw_range.DrawRange.takes_ceiling accepts any experiment interval written at the ceiling whose draw clears idle, so 14 ceiling-probe intervals in which the load sat under the pump's minimum (drawn 1.5 kW, the floor) make draw_range.solve_band book max_kw 1.5 kW ('measured_below_configured') for a pump configured and truly able to draw 5.6-6.0 kW: a 4.10 kW narrowing below a draw the store never observed, while the uncensored arm keeps 6.0 and still learns a genuine 4.0 kW top.
findings.mechanism: The store's median (learned_max_kw) is read as the pump's top with no test that the probe's draw was capacity-limited rather than load-limited; censoring at the modulation floor is indistinguishable from a small pump. solve_band then clamps every solve's max_electrical_power to it (for CEILING_LAPSE_DAYS, until CEILING_OVERDRAWS ordinary ceiling-written overdraws clear the store).

evidence.contention_note: fan-out, up to three seats on the box; a power figure, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-floor: takes_ceiling refuses a draw within AGREE_TOLERANCE of the window's metered running floor (DrawRange.observed()[0])

findings.metric_definition: narrowing_kw = true pump top - solve_band(...).max_kw after the probe; identity 0 where the top was never observed
findings.phenomenon_property: The draw range a solve books never falls below a draw the samples could not observe: a probe interval whose draw sits at the metered running floor (load-limited, censored) is no evidence of the pump's top.

null_control.note: samples=uncensored, true top 5.6: solve_max 6.0 (not_below_configured), narrowing <= 0; true top 4.0: learned 4.0, the honest narrowing the store exists for, kept under the perturbation

findings.title: The sysid adoption interval under-covers under 0.1 C quantisation and 0.02-0.05 C noise: 19 of 43 admitted fits miss it
findings.claim: Under reading noise the fit is documented to tolerate (0.05 C white) and the 0.1 C quantisation of common room sensors, sysid.adoption_decision admits slab fits whose UA error exceeds the half-width it admitted them on in 9 of 11 (quantised) and 4 of 4 (white 0.05 C) cases, 19 of 43 over the three noisy arms against a nominal 0.05, all biased high (+7 % to +35 %), and the blend carries up to 11.7 % of UA error into house_heat_loss_scale from a learner sitting at the truth; noise-free windows recover UA to 5e-14.
findings.mechanism: slab_ua_adoption_halfwidth combines the profile-likelihood and prior widths in quadrature, both conditional on the reading noise being white with the fitted residual scale; a quantised or larger-noise room series leaves the room temperature (a regressor in the slab fit) noisy, which biases UA upward (errors-in-variables) while the profile width shrinks with the residual fit, so the narrowest (admitted) intervals are the biased ones.

evidence.unit: count (quantised_0.1C admitted fits missing their interval, of 11 admitted)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, up to three seats on the box; seeded counts, contention-immune

findings.metric_definition: misses = admitted fits with |log(UA_fit/UA_true)| > the adoption half-width they were admitted on (95 % interval non-coverage; nominal share 0.05)
findings.phenomenon_property: An admitted sysid fit's adoption interval covers the true UA at its nominal rate under every reading-noise model the fit is built for (white to 0.05 C, 0.1 C quantisation, slow drift), and the blend weight never carries a bias larger than the interval states.

null_control.note: noise-free and 0.005 C white: the interval covers at (better than) nominal; the defect appears only as noise grows

reproduction_steps: Run the harness (about 10 min on a loaded box); read RESULT *_misses and *_admitted per noise kind and the per-cell CELL lines

Leave-one-out over the 10 plant x noise cells with admissions (white_0.02, white_0.05, quantised_0.1C): miss share 19/43 = 0.44; dropping the most favourable cell (white_0.02 s_true 1.25 cr 1.4, 5/5) leaves 14/38 = 0.368
Re-run with --perturb-bar5: every admitted and missed count goes to 0
findings.proposed_fix_scope: sysid: widen the adoption interval for regressor noise (quantisation variance d^2/12, residual autocorrelation) or test the fit's residual whiteness before admitting; a bias check against the declared plant before blending

findings.title: A genuine internal gain is learned at 54-57 % of its size; the heat-loss scale absorbs the rest (-2.75 %)
findings.claim: Driven together on a converged house with a genuine +0.6 kW evening gain (17-22 h) and zero-mean sensor noise, coordinator._fold_internal_gains settles the profile at 0.540-0.569 of the genuine gain over 15 noise x seed cells, while learner_newton_step moves house_heat_loss_scale to 0.9725 (truth 1.0) because both learners fold the same residual; with no genuine gain the profile stays within 0.009 kW of the prior and the scale within 1e-4.
findings.mechanism: _fold_internal_gains steps g += INTERNAL_GAINS_ALPHA*y - INTERNAL_GAINS_RIDGE*(g - g0) on the residual power y left after the live model (which carries the profile through _model_corrections), so its own fixed point is only alpha/(alpha+ridge) = 0.714 of the gain; the share it leaves unexplained is folded into the heat-loss scale on the same interval, which reads extra evening heat as a tighter house and, by lowering UA, explains part of the gain away from the profile (scale and a near-uniform gain offset are near-collinear under a 6 K diurnal swing).

evidence.unit: ratio (learned gain / genuine gain, mean over 3 noise arms x 5 seeds)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, three seats on the box; seeded arithmetic, contention-immune

findings.metric_definition: gain_recovery = mean over the gain hours of (learned profile g_h - prior g0) / (genuine gain), after 120 days of accepted dark intervals; identity 1
findings.phenomenon_property: On a converged heat-loss level, the internal-gains profile converges to a genuine hour-correlated gain and the heat-loss scale stays at the true UA: no learner settles on a fraction of a covariate the other learner absorbs.

null_control.value: no-gain arm: gain_spurious_max 0.0092 kW (white), 0.0046 kW (quantised); scale_bias_nogain_mean +0.0001 (white, quantised)
null_control.note: with no genuine gain neither learner moves under zero-mean noise; the shortfall and the scale bias appear only with a genuine gain

reproduction_steps: Run the harness (about 1 min); read the CELL lines' gain_recovery_mean and scale_bias_genuine_mean per noise arm
Re-run with --perturb-ridge0: gain_recovery_mean rises 0.557 -> 0.775 (the ridge share); the rest is the scale's
The drifting arm's +0.06 scale under a +1.5 K outdoor drift is the scale reading a biased covariate (expected) and is not the claim
findings.proposed_fix_scope: coordinator: fold the gains profile as a zero-mean shape about the level the heat-loss scale owns (or fold the scale on the residual after the profile's hour term), and drop the ridge's bias at the fixed point (shrink the step, not the target)
